question: Who among the following foreign travellers is NOT correctly matched with their respective country they hail from?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peter Mundy – China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Peter Mundy** belonged to England (1600-67).
 
• **Marco polo** was from Italy (1254-1323).
 
• **Ibn Battuta** full name Muhammad Ibn Battuta was a Moroccan traveller who left his home at the young age of 21 back in the 13th century to travel across the world.
 
• **Al-Biruni **was from Khwarizm in present-day Uzbekistan. 
 
 
• He was well versed in several languages: Syriac, Arabic, Persian, Hebrew and, Sanskrit.
 
 
 
• **Hence Peter Mundy is the correct answer. **
